query: I have a 41-year-old male hospitalized now. For males aged 36–46, what's the IQR of inpatient digoxin prescription duration (days)?
final_sql: SELECT (percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY duration) - percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY duration)) AS interquartile_range FROM male_prescriptions;
